sources.entry: Lighttpd - Secure, fast, compliant, and very flexible web server that has been optimized for high-performance environments. (Source Code) BSD-3-Clause C/deb/Docker

summary.name: lighttpd
summary.one_liner: lighttpd (lighttpd1.4) is a secure, fast, and lightweight HTTP web server optimized for high-performance environments with a low memory footprint.
use_cases: load-balancing PHP requests across FastCGI servers
hosting sites with virtual hosts and URL rewriting
summary.what_it_does: The page describes lighttpd as a web server with HTTP/2, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/1.0 support, plus HTTPS via several TLS libraries such as OpenSSL, BoringSSL, LibreSSL, mbedTLS, wolfSSL, GnuTLS and NSS. It supports CGI and FastCGI, along with SCGI, reverse proxying, socket proxying and websocket tunneling, including load-balanced FastCGI across multiple PHP servers. Other features listed include virtual hosts, directory listings, URL rewriting, HTTP redirection, custom error pages, on-the-fly gzip/deflate compression, and basic and digest authentication. Security options include chroot, setting UID/GID, and protecting the docroot.
notable: Very low memory footprint and CPU-load focus
Load-balanced FastCGI, SCGI, reverse proxy and websocket tunnel
Multiple pluggable TLS library options for HTTPS
caveats: Windows support requires compiling under cygwin
Page describes compatibility testing with old clients (IE 6.0, Mozilla 1.x, Konqueror 3.1) and older platforms, so support status for modern systems is not stated
